cloud_model.description: Cloud Gemini model for the second opinion and for the drill's cloud fallback (bundled synthetic data only).

cloud_fallback_model.description: Tried once when cloud_model is overloaded or out of quota.

prompt_set_version.description: Versioned prompt set shipped with the app; recorded in the provenance ledger.

cloud_second_opinion_enabled.description: Lets hospital IT switch the cloud second opinion off centrally.

local_batch_rows.description: Rows per on-device extraction batch (keeps prompts inside Gemini Nano's context window).
